actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The triceratops makes two Gore attacks.

actions.name: Gore
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) Piercing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller and the triceratops moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition. Tyrannosaurus Rex

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The vulture has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the vulture’s al- lies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
